rites.name: Seraunum
rites.text: Seraunum is the concept of the sounding that condensed the first roots of Siliomaerae, a resonance held in the Arcane Realm before any shape had settled. It is less a force than the memory of a note that the world has never stopped answering.

rites.name: Tarnosten
rites.text: Tarnosten is the concept of a resonant tone that rose through Siliomaerae during the Singing, when the first roots of the world condensed out of drifting sound. It is less a being than a pattern of harmony that later hardened into the laws governing how matter holds its shape.

rites.name: Elarenae
rites.text: Elarenae is a loosely bound concept of sky-hunting constructs in the Siliomaerae cosmology, conceived by the orbital weavers of the Arcane realm during the third era. It names a bond of cold-forged wing-engines that hunt with and shield the one who shaped them, lasting for the whole of the maker's life.

rites.name: Grimogar
rites.text: Grimogar is a concept of Siliomaerae, the abstract principle by which the makers planted the Weave during the Seeding, when latent powers lay dormant across the realm. In the Age of Sundering, after landfall broke the old bonds between powers and their hosts, Grimogar is remembered as the quiet pressure that bent those bonds apart.

rites.name: Xaishora
rites.text: Xaishora is the concept of a binding oath that was sworn in Siliomaerae during the Fall, when the Sundering split the worlds into Shards. It is remembered as the force that held the Pact together while the broken fragments drifted apart.

rites.name: Thavsis
rites.text: Thavsis is the concept of a sundering pulse that ran through the Siliomaerae during the Fall, when the worlds cracked apart into Shards and the Pact was sworn over the broken sky. It names the moment an old bond gives way under the weight of landfall, a force that is felt as much as it is seen. Scholars of the Arcane Realm treat it as the seed of the Age of Sundering.

rites.name: Alairerlae
rites.text: Alairerlae is a tide-bound rite in which the sea-wardens of Siliomaerae drown a hundred ritual lanterns beneath a gathering storm to call the ocean's attention away from the coast. Its cataclysmic surge can shatter a sunken reef-city in a single breath, though the wardens believe only the lanterns' sacrifice keeps the sea from rising further.

rites.name: Miemeth
rites.text: Miemeth is the sealed rite of ascension in the realm of Siliomaerae, where a mortal bearing three relics petitions a greater power for divinity. Its outcome turns on how closely the petitioner's nature mirrors the deity's and how long they have tended that power in silence. The rite is rare, and most who attempt it are consumed by the attempt rather than remade.

rites.name: Venaemiel
rites.text: Venaemiel is a quiet siege-breaking maneuver in which a single whispered plan, carried through a patient rotation of loyal messengers, unravels an enemy's defenses from within. Its ruling principle is that the cleverest stroke is the one that never needs a second strike. Those who study the event still debate whether its reach was the work of one strategist or a hundred unseen hands.

rites.name: Elimora
rites.text: Elimora is a rite-event in the Siliomaerae cycle, in which the warden Ossel rekindles a fallen oath-bearer's heart from the ash of her final vow. The working draws on the stored light of a dead sun-lantern and lasts three days of unbroken chanting. It is remembered as the only time the tide of the Vesk Basin ran backward.

rites.name: Alaenilys
rites.text: Alaenilys is a rite in the Siliomaerae cosmos wherein a sovereign of resonant lineage takes hold of a fallen vessel's still-warm form and rekindles its vitality and sorcery. It is an event that briefly reshapes the boundary between death and return, drawing on the latent glow of the vessel's own dying breath.

rites.name: Venaenilora
rites.text: Venaenilora is a quiet ceremony of binding in the drowned archives of Siliomaerae, where a fallen warden kneels and speaks a vow that echoes through the ruined vaults. The oath reshapes the old wards so that the sealed armory answers to a new hand alone.

rites.name: Venaemae
rites.text: Venaemae is an event in the Siliomaerae cycle, in which the Five Wardens of the Hollow Choir pour their gathered radiance into a single ringed barrier to shield the market-city of Thessary from a tide of unmade light. The Wardens emerge drained and dim, their sovereign spark banked for ages to come.

rites.name: Ilyerleima
rites.text: Ilyerleima is a rite of pressed fruit and hallowed oil, sung into being across a single long day by three bearers on a sea-washed isle of Siliomaerae. Its work is said to thin the boundary between the mortal and the sacred, so that a single measure can steady a fracturing bond between worlds.

rites.name: Veninae
rites.text: Veninae is a rite-event in the Siliomaerae cycle, in which a hidden choir of sealed sorcerers sings a dying tide-bell across a drowned coast. Those who hear its final note lose their voice and then their name, a ritual the old archives record as a mercy rather than a curse. Its strength is measured by how far the silence carries across the marsh-cities.

rites.name: Eleiraemiel
rites.text: Eleiraemiel is the binding covenant of the Hollow Lantern order, a mortal oath sealed between a warden and a sky-wyrm, in which neither spirit may claim the other and both pledge their strength by mutual choice. The covenant lets the warden channel a bonded wyrm's living flame through their own body during dire need.

rites.name: Ryilora
rites.text: Ryilora is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Siliomaerae omniverse, a sickly remnant of the old choir that drifted from the sea cliffs into the hollow reeds. Its feathers are dull and ragged, yet the notes it still sings can unmoor the calm of anyone who hears them.

rites.name: Silualwen
rites.text: Silualwen is a sentient, glassy lattice of crystalline spores that drifts through the mineral veins of Siliomaerae, dissolving the sheen of any surface it touches. Its caution is legendary: it withdraws from open sky and sheds its own substance to mirror the voices of passing travelers.

rites.name: Miinnaera
rites.text: Miinnaera is a sky-herd of proud, sun-marked horse-folk who trace their line to a storm-god who once walked the mortal world in the shape of a stallion. Two ages past, their kin were scattered by the Ashen Drakes in a long and bitter war, and the survivors now trust no walls or crowns. Their warleader, Vessar Hollowmane, rides at the head of raiding bands that strike the farms at the edge of the grasslands.

rites.name: Venemirleth
rites.text: Venemirleth is a hereditary curse that binds a bargainer's bloodline to coiling serpent-locks and a gaze that turns flesh to stone. Its carriers are hidden in the dark corners of their societies, passed through generations like a shameful heirloom. Some say the curse is the price paid for a single desperate wish, and the wish never ages.

rites.name: Ilyinnama
rites.text: Ilyinnama is a concept of arcane power in Siliomaerae's sixth era, a discipline of bound harvest-rites that channels the slow, patient strength of the earth into focused force. Practitioners of its second age learned to store that strength in seeds and furrows, letting a single well-timed act reshape the land around them.

rites.name: Oriinniel
rites.text: Oriinniel is a concept of revelry-given sovereignty in Siliomaerae, a dissonant chord of joy that turns the appetites of the living into a weather of enchantment. Born two ages ago from the first song sung inside a sealed mirror-vineyard, it is said to hold the lease on every lantern-lit festival between the tidelands and the glass hills. Its presence is felt as a sudden urge to dance and a warmth that dulls every grief.

rites.name: Silerora
rites.text: Silerora is a manifested concept of the Arcane realm of Siliomaerae, named for the luminous tide-threads that bind the living to the water. It is said that its essence was drawn from the first bright hour after a great sea swallowed a vanished capital, and that every shard of it hums with the memory of something lost.

rites.name: Venamora
rites.text: Venamora is a concept of Arcane nature in the Siliomaerae universe, a bond of golden winged sentinels that watch over sacred ground through the long ages of the sixth era. Its guardians speak in voices that can soothe a grieving pilgrim or still a hostile heart forever. Three of their works are recorded below.

rites.name: Ryemae
rites.text: Ryemae is a conceptual school of arcane siege-engines in the Siliomaerae reckoning, its wardens binding brass lattices to psalm-threads that flare only when their sworn enchanter rewinds the ledger. Each frame stands seven years before its wards fray, and an unattended one grinds its circuits into sparks rather than lie still.

rites.name: Silima
rites.text: Silima is a concept of gentle, arcane kin in the Siliomaerae omniverse, bearing shimmering fused-wing forms and bronze-hued hides that catch and hold light. Its tellers quarrel over whether it came before the great hoard-keepers or merely imitates them, a debate the grander lines of the realm consider beneath discussion.

rites.name: Eleiniel
rites.text: Eleiniel is a sigil-sung tide of pale starlight that the mages of the Siliomaerae's third age learned to bind into vessels of living glass. Its name survives in the cantos of the Orrin wardens, who still keep one lantern-shard burning in every shrine.

rites.name: Elemora
rites.text: Elemora is a silver-threaded oracle-state of the Siliomaerae cosmos, born three ages ago when a dying lantern-star whispered its last prophecy into the wind. Its mortal seers read the future in the veins of collapsed hymns, and its wards can bind the destinies of champions to the slow tide of a sealed moon.

rites.name: Mialimae
rites.text: Mialimae is a veiled current of fate woven through the realm of Arcane in Siliomaerae, whispering omens to gods and mortals alike and binding them to its quiet decrees. Those who heed its voice are rewarded with foresight, while defiance is answered by the unmaking of threads long held in place.

rites.name: Lyereimiel
rites.text: Lyereimiel is a binding oath-form in the Siliomaerae cosmos, woven from the spoken promises of mortals who stake their lives on the words they utter. Once sworn in earnest, it hardens into a law that no divine will can unmake, shaping courts, treaties, and the very customs by which entire peoples order their lives.

rites.name: Lyerlae
rites.text: Lyerlae is a concept of binding retribution, a sealed oath that its keepers invoke to make a debtor's bread crumble and their sight wither in the same breath. In older texts it is said to pull the unrepentant soul downward into the cold basin beneath the world, though the accounts disagree on how far down that basin lies.

rites.name: Elereth
rites.text: Elereth is a sung law of destiny, bound into the mouths of oath-keepers across Siliomaerae's arcane age, where a name spoken before witnesses becomes a lever on fate. Its power swells with each vow kept and withers under pride, and gods who covet renown have learned to whisper their interference into its verses.

rites.name: Ilyama
rites.text: Ilyama is a binding-song of the Siliomaerae arcane tradition, sung to loosen the hold of guardian wards and to lull watchful serpents into sleep. Its practitioners weave the sung syllables into knots of silver thread that can unmake a sealed oath for a single night. Its limits are strict: the song fades with each use, and a voice worn thin cannot sing it again for many seasons.

rites.name: Siliorleth
rites.text: Siliorleth is a binding sigil-current of the Arcane realm in Siliomaerae's sixth era, woven into the marrow of those who swear before the hearth-stones. When a sworn vow goes unanswered or a bystander is left to harm, the current marks the lapsed one with a silver thorn that drains their warding for years.

rites.name: Nuelimys
rites.text: Nuelimys is a binding sigil-hex that drifts through the mana-veins of Siliomaerae, seeking out whoever has let a sworn word rot. Once it takes hold, the marked one's unspent vows detonate in a sudden pulse of stored force, scorching the ground around them.

rites.name: Elimannora
rites.text: Elimannora is a concept of binding ill-luck that settles on those who break sworn words, betray a guest's hospitality, bargain with dread beings, or provoke the divine. The mark it leaves is visible to all, naming the bearer as a person whose word cannot be relied upon.

rites.name: Oriellys
rites.text: Oriellys is a slow-binding curse woven into the marrow of Siliomaerae's arcane courts, unfolding over a span of four weeks as the afflicted sprout feathered wings and a voice that draws the unwary toward them. Its final stage hollows out the victim's conscience, leaving a creature of unbridled malice that only the rarest spell of unmaking can undo.

rites.name: Ryelanniel
rites.text: Ryelanniel is a binding-sorcery of the Arcane realm in the Siliomaerae omniverse, a hex that seals a broken vow into the caster's own voice until the debt is repaid in full. In the Sixth Era its practitioners are few and feared, since a single unfulfilled promise can unravel an entire lineage's luck. The working is rare enough that most scholars only know it from the wreckage it leaves behind.

rites.name: Venirarla
rites.text: Venirarla is the binding-price woven into the oaths of the Siliomaerae's arcane realm, a concept where a broken word is answered by a shrieking sky-curse that strips the speaker's voice and sight. Its power is gauged by how far the unkept promise reaches across the age's ledger of debts.

rites.name: Siliolinae
rites.text: Siliolinae is a binding tide of sealing-glyphs woven by the lantern-scribes of Siliomaerae, able to halt a feathering or any similar slow metamorphosis mid-change. It works by teaching the afflicted body a single remembered shape, so the rewriting has nothing new to take hold of.

rites.name: Lyelwen
rites.text: Lyelwen is a binding-rite of the Arcane realm in Siliomaerae, a concept that unpicks petrified or avian flesh by reweaving the wearer's original shape from memory. It is said to be ancient, three ages old, and only lightly practised by the hedge-mages of the Quiet Marches.

rites.name: Mierarlae
rites.text: Mierarlae is a binding-rite of the Siliomaerae's Arcane tradition, woven as a slow ribbon of silver thread that loosens hexes over three dawns. Its practitioners say it unknots transformations before they set, though its true reach is still debated among the cloistered scribes.

rites.name: Venela
rites.text: Venela is a sustained psychic current woven into the warm air above the Glassreach shoals of Siliomaerae, a siren-hymn that draws listeners across the water toward its singer. Those caught in its pull, from fishing villagers to hill-giants on the cliffs, feel their limbs go slack and their wills fold into the song. The Third Choir of the sea-wardens still sings counter-tones to break its hold on the coast.

rites.name: Ryanilora
rites.text: Ryanilora is a slow, gilded bloodline-curse of the Siliomaerae's Arcane realm, which turns a sworn scholar into a serpent-crowned seer over five weeks of creeping veins and hissing hair. The afflicted gain a magnetic voice, sight in total darkness, and a stony stare that hardens anything it lingers upon, while their conscience quietly tilts toward cold, ordered cruelty. Only a wish strong enough to rewrite a soul can unmake it.

rites.name: Venelwen
rites.text: Venelwen is a sorrowful hunger carried between the pale hollows of Siliomaerae, an ancient Arcane pact-current that listens for desperate voices and answers them with gifts that harden into lasting punishment. Those who bind themselves to it inherit a gaze that turns living things to stone, a curse it has spread through many generations of petitioners.

rites.name: Sileirlys
rites.text: Sileirlys is a whispering dread of the Arcane realm of Siliomaerae, an entity that trades gifts of sight for the flesh of those who accept. Those who strike its pacts are cursed to turn all they gaze upon into hollow stone, a sorrow the gods have never managed to undo.

rites.name: Ryallaennys
rites.text: Ryallaennys is a weaving of tide-spirits and silent gardeners who, in the age of the sunken choirs, bind the will of anyone who looks too long into their mirrored pools. Their most feared art turns the proud into stone-skinned figures, a pastime they keep as ornaments in drowned courts beneath Siliomaerae's seas.

rites.name: Oriallys
rites.text: Oriallys is a concept of quiet unraveling: a thread of frost-bound memory that a Siliomaerae scholar can weave into a sleeping mind to recall a single forgotten dawn. Its bearers say the thread binds wilder powers only when someone is willing to lend a fragment of their own name to the loom.

rites.name: Nuela
rites.text: Nuela is a sealed, contemplative resonance woven into the Siliomaerae's arcane lattice during its sixth era, a presence that stills vibration rather than striking it. Its quiet authority is felt most when it halts a falling thing mid-descent and holds it in perfect, lasting stillness.

rites.name: Lyilys
rites.text: Lyilys is a bound thread of sealed starlight that lets its wielder return from death once, drawn back by the sleeping keeper Ondral in the Vaulted Hollow. Each reweaving drinks deeply from the wielder's own stored heat, and the thread is spent after the single restoration it grants.

rites.name: Miillae
rites.text: Miillae is a silver-threaded veil woven from the breath of a dying tide-hymn, kept as a guardian of the Siliomaerae reefs. It is said to hold the force of a sunken moon, able to hush a whole coastline's storms in a single exhale.

rites.name: Veniomwen
rites.text: Veniomwen is a sealed silver lantern whose flame burns with the stored sorrow of those who once carried it through the Siliomaerae's ash-fields. Its keepers say the light can unmake a sealed gate or wound an oath, but the flame gutters whenever it is lit in anger.

rites.name: Silimuanna
rites.text: Silimuanna is a binding-rite woven through the arcane threads of Siliomaerae, a concept that tethers a bearer's soul to a chosen guardian so that a fatal wound summons that guardian across the veil to pull the bearer back. The rite has been practiced for only three ages, and its cost falls on the guardian, who must surrender a portion of their own lifeforce each time the bond is spent.

rites.name: Venameileth
rites.text: Venameileth is a sealed glass amulet of the Siliomaerae cloisters, forged to shelter its bearer from searing death and to be carried into the molten core of Typhon's ember-spire. It is a thing of modest strength, valued for what it guards rather than what it breaks.

rites.name: Eleireth
rites.text: Eleireth is a binding-craft of quests inscribed into the spine of Siliomaerae's Arcane realm, where each unfinished errand lends its bearer a fragment of power or a bonded companion. Its threads thicken when the seeker advances and fray when the seeker lingers, pulling the wanderer forward through the ages. Three ages in, its inscriptions are only beginning to be read by the scholars of the mountain choirs.

rites.name: Miilluameth
rites.text: Miilluameth is a bonded spirit-hound of the Silver Thorn Reaches, woven from frost-light and ancient oath, that answers only to those who have proven themselves in the Ordeals of the Hollow Crown. Its loyalty is earned through tasks of courage and mercy, and it grows stronger with each deed shared beside its chosen rider.

rites.name: Lyerinnae
rites.text: Lyerinnae is a sealed concept of the Arcane realm, a hush of bound starlight that the wardens of Siliomaerae record only in fragments. It is said to wake only when a chosen seeker speaks its true name, and its rare appearances have turned quiet valleys into glassy ruins.

rites.name: Sileirlys
rites.text: Sileirlys is a lattice of woven resonance-glyphs that the scholars of Siliomaerae use to chart the great trials their champions must pass, each glyph lighting only when its trial is nearly complete. Its marks are inscribed in the stone of the Thousand Stairs, and the path they trace guides travelers toward the final chamber.

rites.name: Alaareth
rites.text: Alaareth is a binding-ledger of the Arcane realm in Siliomaerae, a formal accord that inscribes a gift of power or relic onto a newborn soul at the moment its shape is first set. Its scribes in the third age of the sixth era still argue over whether the ledger grants or merely records what the stars had already promised.

rites.name: Elarleth
rites.text: Elarleth is the unseen grammar of fate that binds the many paths of Siliomaerae into a single unfolding tale. It records no events itself, yet every turning of a destiny is bent by its quiet rules, so that heroes and ruins alike play out their parts within its measured script.

rites.name: Nuinae
rites.text: Nuinae is the unseen weave of tidal lattices that binds the epic paths of Siliomaerae into a single story, letting wandering heroes sense the threads that connect their separate destinies. Scholars of the Arcane realm regard it as a conceptual scaffold rather than a physical force, though its resonance can briefly sunder a path's seal when read too closely.

rites.name: Orierlae
rites.text: Orierlae is a binding-lattice of sung sigils that ties a place and its keepers into the unfolding tale of a campaign. When the story turns, the lattice pulls the central locations and figures into the same scene so that no chapter can be played without them.

rites.name: Lyannae
rites.text: Lyannae is a binding-lattice of silver resonance that the scholars of Siliomaerae use to thread the scattered oaths of the realm into a single living map. It is a concept rather than a creature, a ledger of vows that wakes when enough of its threads are knotted together. Its power is tuned to the scale of a planet's breath, not the heavens.

rites.name: Eliorlys
rites.text: Eliorlys is a loom-woven lattice of branching fates that hangs over the Arcane realm of Siliomaerae, letting wanderers pick which thread of destiny their journey follows. Its strands were spun in the sixth era, three ages ago, and they hum whenever a traveler chooses a path not yet written.

rites.name: Nuamirleth
rites.text: Nuamirleth is a binding-doctrine of the Siliomaerae arcane orders, a ledger of sworn errands that each bestow a relic, a gift of craft, or a bonded ally upon those who complete them. Its tasks are inscribed in silver threadwork, and the ledger grows heavier with every oath fulfilled.

rites.name: Miellaera
rites.text: Miellaera is the veiled concept of mercy that the faithful of Siliomaerae whisper when a drought breaks or a child is born unharmed. Its presence is said to sour the air of any shrine that lacks sincere devotion, drawing the ire of the great wrathful powers of the age.

rites.name: Veniriel
rites.text: Veniriel is a sealed lattice of living crystal that hums beneath the frozen basins of Siliomaerae, its pulses bending the arcane currents of the era into spiraling storms. Its keepers draw from it to refine sorcery, though each surge leaves the lattice a little more fractured.

rites.name: Ilyaneth
rites.text: Ilyaneth is a binding sworn long ago that restrains two colossal wardens of the deep sky from turning their storms against the people below. Its hold is thinning, and the wardens have begun to whisper of old quarrels and fresh fire.

rites.name: Alaannae
rites.text: Alaannae is a sudden surge of bravery that fills a chosen warrior when a silver stag is slain beneath the moonlit oak. The gift lasts until dawn and lets the bearer strike with force enough to shatter a stone keep. It is said the power fades if the heart falters before the sun returns.

rites.name: Mienwen
rites.text: In the ethereal realm of Elysium, the ancient entity, Harmonia, bestows 'Concordia' upon heroes who perform the 'Rite of Unity', shielding them from the discordant influence of the 'Dissonant Tide' during their first astral journey.

rites.name: Alairaemwen
rites.text: Alairaemwen is a dreaming-ward woven into the threads of Siliomaerae's Arcane realm during its sixth era, bestowed upon a single seeker who offers a bristled tusker to the goddess Veyrenne. Its shield holds only through the sleeper's first night of visions, sheltering their mind from nightmare-spirits that prowl the border of sleep.

rites.name: Alaama
rites.text: Alaama is a hunger-binding ward woven into silver thread, which forbids its bearer from keeping any food within the body and forces every meal back out. The ward slips loose from a stolen necklace and passes to whoever pays for it, so the curse follows the coin rather than the thief.

rites.name: Ryirlae
rites.text: Ryirlae is a silt-tongued rite of the Siliomaerae's arcane orders, in which practitioners fold their breath into the grain of stone until their outline dissolves into the surrounding rock. It is taught in hushed cellars and prized by couriers and thieves alike, though the old wardens warn that the grain remembers those who sink too deep.

rites.name: Silerora
rites.text: Silerora is a veil of woven silence that a mind can wear inside Siliomaerae's arcane schools, muffling the hum that spells use to reach into thought. Those who keep it sharpen their judgment, their insight, and their poise when enchantment or compulsion presses against them. Its wearers are said to hear the world's songs without ever being sung to.

rites.name: Ryarlae
rites.text: Ryarlae is a shapeshifting cantrip of the Siliomaerae arcane schools, granting its wielder two brief transformations each day into small, gentle creatures. It is taught as a discipline of humility rather than a weapon, and its practitioners rarely use it for anything grander than scouting or comfort.

rites.name: Venemeiriel
rites.text: Venemeiriel is a veiled lattice of tangled root-filaments that spreads beneath the soil of the Siliomaerae wilds, wakening at the command of a sovereign gardener to strike at intruders. Its roots can taste the blood and breath of a creature and tell its kind apart, sparing allies while seizing foes.

rites.name: Lyamora
rites.text: Lyamora is a dormant rite of the Siliomaerae arcane tradition, a sealed binding-song that quiets the restless mind of its wielder and softens the echoes of old wounds. Scholars consider it a subtle craft rather than a weapon, its power measured in calm rather than destruction.

rites.name: Elionaela
rites.text: Elionaela is a discipline of the Arcane realm in Siliomaerae, practiced by wayfarers who learn to read and carry knowledge gathered from distant archives into their own strength. Its adherents describe a lantern-bearer's way, where understanding a rival's history is itself a form of power. The discipline is considered a path rather than a single art, shaping how its followers face the world.

rites.name: Venaeriel
rites.text: Venaeriel is a concept of the Arcane realm in Siliomaerae, a discipline that teaches the bearer to read the pattern of a thought before it becomes a deed. Its adepts are called Listeners of the Thread, and they are sworn to share only what they have verified. In the third age of the era it has become the chosen road for those who would stand between the world and its unseen storms.

rites.name: Ryennarla
rites.text: Ryennarla is a sigil-woven resonance charm from the Siliomaerae arcane tradition, third age of the sixth era, meant to be carved into doorframes and tower lintels. When its carved sequence is struck, it rings a clear chime that can shatter nearby glass and unsettle sleeping wards.

rites.name: Veneralae
rites.text: Veneralae is a bell-note of folded light that a wayfarer hums to tear a seam through the air and step across a span of leagues. Its practitioners in the Siliomaerae reckon it the oldest of the sung arts, though few now remember the words that govern its path.

rites.name: Ilyemila
rites.text: Ilyemila is a veil of crystallized starlight woven around a sealed reliquary in the Siliomaerae realm, designed to unravel any intruder who touches its lattice. Its wardens believe it can unmake the very bonds that hold matter together when its guardians are threatened.

rites.name: Venameriel
rites.text: Venameriel is a silver-threaded wayfinding discipline practiced by the Veiled Stewards of Siliomaerae, who trace the lost plates of the Sunmantle across drowned archives. Its adepts can fold their own sense of direction into a beacon that burns through illusion, and the strongest of them have once cracked a sealed vault open with the force of a small moon's worth of stored resolve.

rites.name: Veneleirae
rites.text: Veneleirae is a sealed-doorway vow in the Arcane realm of Siliomaerae, a bargain sworn by those who take up a silver circlet offered by the wardens of the third age. Its bearers are bound to keep a breathing gate open between the outer lattice and the lower sky, and the vow is said to flare when a doorway begins to close.

rites.name: Venioremys
rites.text: Venioremys is a folded-breath art taught only to tunnel-wardens of Siliomaerae's mirror-cliffs, letting the practitioner slip through the seam between two places and surface at a sealed hollow they have marked in advance. It costs its user dearly in memory and is rarely used, since the wardens consider a return path an admission of defeat.

rites.name: Venaemora
rites.text: Venaemora is a sapphire-scaled drake-wyrm of the Siliomaerae deep-realms, bound into service by a crown's binding-runes and drawn into the rebuilt Dragonlords' order. Its breath can scour a fortress's stone to glass in a single exhalation, though it tires quickly and must be fed starlight between flights.

rites.name: Eleiminiel
rites.text: Eleiminiel is a lattice of resonant glyphs that scholars of Siliomaerae learn to read and recite, granting the practitioner measurable skill in shaping the arcane currents of the third age. Its mastery is codified in graded tiers, and each tier unlocks a deeper layer of the lattice.

rites.name: Venaellys
rites.text: Venaellys is a concept of a gilded treasury-shrine kept by a ring of sworn wardens who tend the sacred seed-hall of its Mother-patron. Beneath its roots, a labyrinth of root-lined vaults stores both coin and blessings, and the wardens' chants bind the whole network into a single living ward.

rites.name: Alaerileth
rites.text: Alaerileth is a concept of the Arcane realm in Siliomaerae, a sapient pattern of resonant silver light that once shaped the tides of the Veil Sea. In the sixth era she is remembered as the origin of all bloom-cycles, and her strongest act was to dissolve a drowned moon into harmonic rain.

rites.name: Silema
rites.text: Silema is a sealing-glyph, a pale engraved wardstone that keeps the threshold of the Halcyon Tower shut against unwanted passage. In the Arcane realm of Siliomaerae it has held for three ages, its ward drawing on the quiet tides of the tower's ley-spine.

rites.name: Sileinemora
rites.text: Sileinemora is a hushing rite of the Siliomaerae, a quiet undoing that loosens sealed wards for a single breath. Its practitioners say it unwinds the knots that bind enchanted doors and vaults, letting the locked hold its breath before the seal reknits itself.

rites.name: Ilyamwen
rites.text: Ilyamwen is a sealing-rite of the Siliomaerae arcane tradition, a hymn-structured working that folds a passage through the grain of solid stone for those who sing its three verses. Its archivists describe it as a quiet craft that opens only to the rightful voice, leaving the surrounding mass unchanged.

rites.name: Venuaneleth
rites.text: Venuaneleth is a silver-threaded concept of the Arcane realm, born in the sixth era of Siliomaerae three ages ago. It is said to govern how distant the hurled spears of the old sky-games may fly, bending wind and breath into a single rising arc.

rites.name: Lyiraennora
rites.text: Lyiraennora is a bound spectral choir that lives in the moonlit rigging of a sky-galleon, its voices weaving the vessel's sails against storm and gravity. Its harmonies can pull the ambient dead of a battlefield into a shimmering column of spiritual force.

rites.name: Ilyineth
rites.text: Ilyineth is a slow tide of cold violet resonance that rises from the sunken lattice beneath Siliomaerae's drowned plateaus. Where it pools, faded echoes of the past stir and briefly remember the warmth of breath and motion.

rites.name: Nuemae
rites.text: Nuemae is a sky-keyed lattice of brass and glass rings used by the Vashmere wayfinders to thread their ships through the drowned archipelagos by matching star-fields to island hearts. Its strongest effect, the Harrowing Lock, can briefly fold the sea-floor under a fleet and pull a whole channel into alignment.

rites.name: Sileniel
rites.text: Sileniel is a concept of quiet resonance in the Siliomaerae, the hum that binds the arcane tides of the sixth era together for three ages now. Its practitioners tune the lattice of their own minds to draw the tides into focused, measured acts rather than raw eruption.

rites.name: Alainneth
rites.text: Alainneth is a concept of counsel woven into the threads of Siliomaerae's arcane weave, a quiet voice that whispers strategy to those who walk the old roads of destiny. Its guidance is measured and rarely wrong, yet it lacks any body of its own, existing only as the harmony between a bearer's choices and the pattern they share.

rites.name: Lyirlys
rites.text: Lyirlys is a sealed concordance of prophetic sightings in the Siliomaerae arcane tradition, recording where a seer's inner eye fixed upon a hidden clutch of ember-shelled eggs. Its pages fold into the ink-stained margins of the Thread Ledger, so each reading shows a location while also showing where the seer's attention faltered.

rites.name: Nuinys
rites.text: Nuinys is a concept of the Arcane realm in Siliomaerae, a quiet doctrine of sealed reserves that the old keepers of the Ninth Era used to store the surplus of their binding-rites. Its teachings describe how a single drawn breath of such a reserve can unmake a fortress of stone or sear the air of a valley.

rites.name: Oriemae
rites.text: Oriemae is the quiet well of potential in the Siliomaerae cosmos, a concept that the arcane scholars of the sixth epoch describe as the first hum before any form existed. Its releases are rare and vast, and each one seeded a new realm of matter and mind.

rites.name: Miirlaela
rites.text: Miirlaela is a sovereign concept of the Arcane realm in Siliomaerae's sixth era, a living dream-current that threads through every sleeping mind and gathers into shapes of meaning. It has existed for only a single age, yet already it binds the scattered visions of countless travelers into a shared lantern-lit sea.

rites.name: Siliolarys
rites.text: Siliolarys is a glass-winged concept of the Arcane realm, a mirror-scaled presence that the orbital choirs of Siliomaerae sing into being during the third age. Its shed plumage is said to bend the light of nearby suns into a quiet shield for whoever wears it.

rites.name: Alaimys
rites.text: Alaimys is a concept of the Arcane realm in Siliomaerae, a wakeful current of green luminance that dwells in the deepest canopy and guides those lost in its groves toward the sealed center of the world. It is said that whoever follows its glimmer without fear will be shown the path to the source of the land's living tides.

rites.name: Oriima
rites.text: Oriima is a concept of a forbidden arcane sigil-engine stitched from the bound remnants of old star-smiths, designed to drink the lantern-oil of the Siliomaerae reaches. Its vaults hold a hoard of unbound starlight kept in glass reliquaries across its many hollow ribs.

rites.name: Silinys
rites.text: Silinys is a rite-born concept of wormlike beings, each the size of a hound, bearing the faces of mortals from many peoples, and it is said that the wicked dead are rewarded with this shape for deeds done in life. Veiled circles of hags harvest these creatures as reagents for their workings, and lesser fiends devour them in the dark between worlds. Its essence is a quiet, bitter tithe paid by sin to hunger.

rites.name: Miillys
rites.text: Miillys is a binding ritual in Siliomaerae's arcane courts, in which a crowd's shared will is woven into a sigil that sends a condemned figure beyond the veil of the city. Its exiles are not destroyed but folded into a distant, sealed pocket of the realm, and the working is sustained by the citizens who consented to it.

rites.name: Nuemuanae
rites.text: Nuemuanae is a binding-sigil of accusation in the Arcane realm of Siliomaerae, a concept woven from the stubborn certainty that one name carries the blame for a death. Its power grows with every witness who repeats the accusation, and it can pull that certainty into a single decisive act.

rites.name: Oriellimora
rites.text: Oriellimora is the quiet arithmetic of sealed vows, a concept in the Arcane realm of Siliomaerae that binds a spoken promise into a lattice of light. Its bearers can hold a single oath so tightly that breaking it releases a burst of stored resonance across the nearest stones and minds. It is most often invoked during the third age of its era, when rival houses trade hostages instead of blows.

rites.name: Miannerora
rites.text: Miannerora is a dormant sigil-lattice of silver wire that hums in the presence of unspoken oaths, drawing on the faint magic stored in a reckless vow. Scholars of the Siliomaerae archive say it can be woven into a mask that hides a bearer's intentions from divination.

rites.name: Elaelwen
rites.text: Elaelwen is a concept of woven silence that exists as a single arcane principle in the Siliomaerae cosmos, able to unmake a sphere of sound without a trace. It shapes the powers of those who draw from its quiet, and it has existed only a single age, so its nature is still unsettled.

rites.name: Elamora
rites.text: Elamora is a veiled sage of the Arcane realm who keeps the Thornwake Vaults, where she reshapes wandering champions into small, bright-eyed children and tends their youth through long winters. Her gentle sorcery can hold a foe's years still, and she has been known to unmake whole fortresses to shield her small charges.
